content.title: Veon to list Kyivstar on Nasdaq, signs LOI with Cohen Circle
content.summary: VEON (VEON) and Cohen Circle Acquisition Corp. I (CCRI) announced the signing of a letter of intent (“LOI”) to enter into a business combination with the aim of indirectly listing Kyivstar, VEON’s digital operator in Ukraine, on the Nasdaq Stock Market in the United States. Completion of this transaction would make Kyivstar the first purely Ukrainian investment opportunity to be publicly listed on a U.S. stock exchange, enabling U.S. and other international investors to participate more directly
